experiments.name: control
experiments.hypothesis: N3-0 (control of the night, settings of night 2 fine_es): continuing from the best model of night 2, self-play of the best own model raises the gain above night 2 (RANDOM 0.355, SMART 0.043) from iteration to iteration

experiments.name: temp_low
experiments.hypothesis: H-D5: self-play temperature 0.2 instead of 0.5 (less exploration noise in the recorded player's own moves) gives a higher gain than control; risk: less variety. val_loss is NOT comparable with control here (other data)

experiments.name: cap8
experiments.hypothesis: H-D3: at most 8 rows of a game per decision type in the training pool (instead of 32) loses nothing: val_loss - constant and gain not worse than control (the rows of a game are near-duplicates)
